integrity: The exhaustive census enumerates every nondecreasing chain map and every unordered pair of binary letter maps, which represents every ordered pair up to letter exchange. Pair synchronization is exact because, in a monotonic automaton, synchronizing a subset is equivalent to synchronizing its minimum and maximum. An independent forward BFS replays the length-nine witness.
scientific_limitations: The threshold is determined only for one and through nine states. The exact extremal count is in a normalized preserved-chain presentation, so abstract automata with multiple preserved orders may have multiple presentations. No claim is made for n at least 10.
title: The first binary monotonic subset-synchronization excess occurs at nine states
